title: Robust McKean--Vlasov Variational Systems with Asymmetric Loss Aversion: Well-Posedness, Stability, and Propagation of Chaos for the Forward and Regularized Backward Systems
summary: We study a class of robust forward--backward McKean--Vlasov variational systems under model uncertainty represented by a non-dominated family of probability measures. Mean-field interactions are described through nonlinear collective observables acting on the laws of the forward and backward components. To model asymmetric loss aversion, we introduce a nonsmooth convex functional whose subdifferential defines a law-dependent maximal monotone operator acting on the forward state.
